question: Do richer complex databases (hu.MAP 2.0) raise the trustworthy coverage above 55%?
method: leave-one-out predict a measured gene's knockout effect from its complex partners (in the gwps screen); Pearson r vs real.
verdict: REJECTED. hu.MAP physical complexes do NOT confer knockout predictability (r~0.09 even at confidence 5, vs curated 0.23). Physical co-purification != a functional unit sharing a knockout effect. Adding them inflates the trustworthy COUNT (55->67%) without adding capability. Coverage stays 55% (curated complexes, r=0.23). Raising it needs more INTERVENTIONAL data, not more complex annotation.
